chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa, from Muhammad bin Khalid al-Barqi, from the one he mentioned, from Hafs bin Ghiyath, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And all of them, We devastated a (complete) devastation». He said: It means: We crushed a (complete) crushing. He said: It is in Nabatean.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'tabarna tatbira' in Surah Al-A'raf according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interpreting the Quranic phrase 'kullan tabarna tatbira' as denoting total destruction, while highlighting its linguistic root in the Nabatean dialect to clarify its semantic intensity. This exegesis underscores the Imam's role in elucidating subtle linguistic nuances within the Quran, reinforcing the Shia tradition that the Ahl al-Bayt possess the authoritative key to understanding divine revelation. The emphasis on 'complete crushing' serves as a theological reminder of God's absolute power over the fate of the righteous and the wicked.
